title: Érdy-kódex (Sermones Compilati research group, ELTE)
institution: Sermones Compilati research group, ELTE BTK, Budapest
notes: The Érdy codex, a Hungarian-language sermon and legend manuscript copied in 1526-1527, set out in a table with photographs of the manuscript pages, a letter-by-letter (diplomatic) transcription and related studies, plus a link to the 19th-century printed edition. At the time of checking, 108 pages are transcribed (pages 001-055 and 103-157); the rest of the critical edition is marked 'in preparation'. The server reports a last modification in 2014 for the page and nothing newer was found, so the resource is listed as archived. The Sermones site is still maintained for other projects such as the exempla database. The counts cover the 108 transcribed pages only, and the codex is counted as one text. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: No licence or rights statement on the Érdy codex page, its transcription pages, or the Sermones Compilati home and group pages (the only footer-type text is ELTE's generic error page 'All rights reserved'); no repository or TEI headers found for this edition (checked 2026-10-13).
